name: The Count
source:
Main character heads to Count Dracula castle to rescue travelers lost in stormy weather. There are only three days given to defeat the vampire with the help of garlic and holy cross.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1985.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角前往德古拉伯爵城堡营救在暴风雨天气中迷路的旅行者。在大蒜和圣十字的帮助下击败吸血鬼只有三天的时间。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1985.html]vndbreview[/url]]
